generic_no_command: The instance {tool} does not declare the executable (command).
generic_bad_args: The args of the instance {tool} must be a list of strings, never a shell line.
generic_bad_config: The instance {tool} declares the config block outside the generic command contract: {detail}
generic_schema_missing: The evidence schema {file} of the instance {tool} does not exist or leaves the workspace.
generic_schema_invalid: The evidence schema {file} of the instance {tool} does not compile: {detail}
generic_missing_executable: The executable {executable} was not found on the PATH.
generic_timeout: The command exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
generic_no_invocation: The plan has no generic command invocation for the instance {tool}.
generic_reason_failed: {executable} ended with code {code}, outside the success codes ({expected}).
generic_evidence_missing: The evidence file {file} was not generated: {detail}
generic_evidence_invalid: The evidence {file} does not satisfy the schema {schema}: {detail}
generic_reason_evidence: {executable} ended with code {code} and the evidence {file} satisfies the schema.
generic_condition_boolean: Boolean check: only the exit code is the result, with no findings.
generic_condition_runner: The exit code of {runner} is the verdict of the tests.
generic_condition_evidence: Passes only if the command ends successfully and writes {file} according to {schema}.
generic_partial: Partial support: the stack has no dedicated adapter; the result is only the exit code of the declared command.
generic_unproven_category: The command declares {capability} ({category}) without a verifiable evidence contract ({need}); it runs, but does not cover the category.
generic_need_json_or_runner: kind json-file with a schema or test-runner
